rationale: Luqman is building AI video generation tools for creators at Neural Studio, while Yunbin specializes in AI UX and human-computer interaction at Heurica—a natural complement since accessible creative tools require thoughtful product design. Both are San Francisco-based founders working at the intersection of generative AI and user experience, and could explore how HCI research and UX expertise might strengthen the creator tools Luqman is building.
intro_message: Luqman Elbakri, meet Yunbin Bae — you're both building AI products in SF with complementary focuses: Luqman on video generation for creators and Yunbin on AI UX and human-computer interaction.
